points: When the children of Israel cried unto the Most High, he raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded. Notice how the Most High raised up judges of different tribes also: Othniel of Judah, now Ehud of Benjamin.

note.label: Judges 3: Nations Left to Prove Israel

points: Ehud makes a two edged dagger of a cubit length, girds it under his raiment on his right thigh, and brings the present to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

note.label: Judges 3: Nations Left to Prove Israel

points: Saying, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king, Ehud gets Eglon alone in his summer parlour, tells him, I have a message from God unto thee, and thrusts the dagger into his belly with his left hand, and the fat closes upon the blade so he cannot draw it out. Ehud goes forth and locks the doors of the parlour.

note.label: Judges 3: Nations Left to Prove Israel
